102	    "finding": "👮 **Wachiman** · 🟡🐛 **Consider · bug: Disk reads in resolvePending and applyFolder no longer fence off a slower refresh**\n\nBefore this change, every `remember` bumped the generation. 1285	- whether iCloud "Desktop & Documents" keeps `~/Documents` at the same path. Apple says the
1286	  contents are stored in iCloud Drive (https://support.apple.com/en-us/ht206985) but not where
1287	  the path resolves, so the xattr check above is the safety net;
1288	- conflict copies when the same folder is open on two Macs.
1289	
1290	### IPC changes
1291	
1292	New channels (main ↔ renderer):
1293	
1294	| Channel                      | Payload → result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
1295	| ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
1296	| `workspaces:list`            | → `{ activeId, generation, hintDismissed, workspaces: { id, name, color, initials, path, sync, state: "available" \| "unavailable", reason?, warnings? }[], orphanCloudCount }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
1297	| `workspaces:add`             | opens the folder picker; adopts or initializes → the entry, or null when cancelled                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
1298	| `workspaces:switch`          | `id` → ok, or `{ reason: "busy" \| "unavailable" \| "cancelled" }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
1299	| `workspaces:rename`          | **Shipped in part 1b as `workspaces:edit`**: `{ id, name?, color? }` → `{ ok, workspace, savedToFolder }`; initials follow the name unless the user chose them (an initials editor is not built)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
1300	| `workspaces:create`          | **Part 1b.** `{ name, color }` → creates `Kaipu Record — <name>` next to the Default workspace's folder, then switches; refused for a name in use or a folder that exists and is not empty; part 2 adds `activate: false` ("Move to ▸ New workspace…" keeps it inactive), and `workspaces:add` takes the same option                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
1301	| `workspaces:check-location`  | **Part 1b.** `name` → `{ path, state: "free" \| "empty" \| "not-empty" \| "parent-missing" }`, what the dialog shows before creating                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
1302	| `workspaces:relocate`        | **Part 1b.** `id` → opens the folder picker, then points the workspace at the picked folder (no file is moved or copied) → `{ ok, workspace }`, or `{ ok: false, reason, workspaceName? }`. Accepted only when the folder's `identity.json` has the same id; refused for another identity (named), `.kaipu` items with no identity, an empty or plain folder, a folder registered as another workspace, an unreadable identity, and while a recording or export runs. The active workspace runs through the switch transaction |
1303	| `workspaces:remove`          | `id` → ok (refused for the active one and for the last one)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
1304	| `workspaces:delete`          | `id` → ok or `{ reason: "active" \| "no-trash" \| "busy" }` after main shows the confirmation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
1305	| `workspaces:open-folder`     | `id` → reveals the folder                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
1306	| `workspaces:move-item`       | **Part 2: not a channel of its own.** A single move is a group of one through `workspaces:move-items`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
1307	| `workspaces:move-items`      | **Part 2.** Stamped: `{ items: { id, assetId }[], targetId }` → `workspaces:move-progress` events (`{ current, total }`), then `{ targetId, moved: { id, newId }[], failed: { id, reason }[], skipped: id[] }`. The renderer decides the exports (decision 21) and sends them as items; a group of single moves                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
1308	| `workspaces:cancel-move`     | → ok; the move in flight finishes, no further one starts                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
1309	| `workspaces:dismiss-hint`    | → ok; stores `hintDismissedAt` in `preferences.json`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
1310	| `workspaces:assign-cloud`    | `ids, targetId` → ok per id; calls `PUT /assets/{assetId}/workspace` (Settings → Workspaces, "Assign to workspace…")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
1311	| `workspaces:download-item`   | `{ workspaceId, id }` → progress events, then ok or a reason (synced, evicted media)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
1312	| `workspaces:changed` (event) | broadcast after any registry change or switch, with the generation; windows re-list                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
1313	| `settings:get-scoped`        | `scope` (`"all"` or a workspace id) → `{ all, overrides, effective, pending }`; `pending` holds folder overrides awaiting confirmation                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
1314	| `settings:set-override`      | `workspaceId, key, value \| null` → effective settings; refused for a non-overridable key or an unavailable workspace; records the written file's hash                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
1315	| `settings:resolve-pending`   | `workspaceId, "use" \| "ignore", sha256` → effective settings; stores the file's sha256 and the decision in `userData/workspace-settings.json` (decision 26). **Part 3:** `sha256` is the hash the user saw; a file that changed since is refused with `changed`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
1316	| `settings:reset-overrides`   | **Part 3.** `workspaceId, keys` → effective settings; removes several overrides in one write (the section banner's "Reset to default")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
1317	| `settings:copy-to-all`       | **Part 3.** `workspaceId, keys` → `{ settings, keptOwn }`; the workspace's values become the All level's and every workspace drops its own override of them. `keptOwn` names the ones that could not be cleared                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
1318	
1319	Changed: every item-scoped channel (`listLocalRecordings`, `loadCursorTrack`,
1320	`renameLocalRecording`, `markOpenedInEditor`, `setItemTags`, `backfillLocalRecordingMeta`,
1321	`deleteLocalRecording`, `revealLocalRecording`, `startFileDrag`, `videoEditSaveSession`,
1322	`videoEditLoadSession`, screenshot load, copy-by-id and overwrite, and the tag registry
1323	channels) takes `workspaceId` first, plus the workspace generation. Main rejects an unknown or
1324	unavailable id, and **any id or generation that is not the active one** with `stale-workspace`.

| `settings:resolve-pending`   | `workspaceId, "use" \| "ignore", sha256` → effective settings; stores the file's sha256 and the decision in `userData/workspace-settings.json` (decision 26). **Part 3:** `sha256` is the hash the user saw; a file that changed since is refused with `changed`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `settings:reset-overrides`   | **Part 3.** `workspaceId, keys` → effective settings; removes several overrides in one write (the section banner's "Reset to default")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `settings:copy-to-all`       | **Part 3.** `workspaceId, keys` → `{ settings, keptOwn }`; the workspace's values become the All level's and every workspace drops its own override of them. `keptOwn` names the ones that could not be cleared                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

Changed: every item-scoped channel (`listLocalRecordings`, `loadCursorTrack`,
`renameLocalRecording`, `markOpenedInEditor`, `setItemTags`, `backfillLocalRecordingMeta`,
`deleteLocalRecording`, `revealLocalRecording`, `startFileDrag`, `videoEditSaveSession`,
`videoEditLoadSession`, screenshot load, copy-by-id and overwrite, and the tag registry
channels) takes `workspaceId` first, plus the workspace generation. Main rejects an unknown or
unavailable id, and **any id or generation that is not the active one** with `stale-workspace`.

160	/**
161	 * Discriminated result for the browser sign-in IPC calls. A structured AuthError does not
162	 * survive a *thrown* IPC error — Electron serializes anything thrown out of `ipcMain.handle`
163	 * down to its `.message` alone, so a `{ kind }` payload would arrive as an opaque Error and
164	 * every failure would collapse into the generic copy. Returning the error round-trips cleanly.
165	 */
166	export type AuthAttemptResult = { ok: true; status: AuthStatus } | { ok: false; error: AuthError };
167	
168	/** Per-workspace setting overrides (ADR 0034). Every call names the scope or workspace it acts on. */
169	export interface SettingsScopeBridge {
170	  /** One scope: "all" (the All workspaces level) or a workspace id. */
171	  getScoped(scope: SettingsScope): Promise<ScopedSettings>;
172	  /** Override one key for a workspace; `null` removes it (Reset). Returns effective settings. */
173	  setOverride(
174	    workspaceId: string,
175	    key: OverridableKey,
176	    value: unknown | null,
177	  ): Promise<SetOverrideResult>;
178	  /** Remove several overrides of one workspace at once. */
179	  resetOverrides(
180	    workspaceId: string,
181	    keys: readonly OverridableKey[],
182	  ): Promise<ResetOverridesResult>;
183	  /** Make the workspace's values the All level's and drop every workspace's own override of them. */
184	  copyToAll(workspaceId: string, keys: readonly OverridableKey[]): Promise<CopyToAllResult>;
185	  /** Answer "This workspace brings its own settings"; `sha256` names the file the user saw. */
186	  resolvePending(
187	    workspaceId: string,
188	    decision: "use" | "ignore",
189	    sha256: string,
190	  ): Promise<ResolvePendingResult>;
191	}
192	
193	/**
194	 * Workspaces (ADR 0032). Item-scoped calls elsewhere on this bridge carry the window's
195	 * workspace stamp, added by the preload: a call made before a switch and answered after it
196	 * rejects with `stale-workspace` instead of resolving with the other workspace's data.
197	 */
198	export interface WorkspacesBridge {
199	  list(): Promise<WorkspacesState>;
200	  /** The workspace this window's stamp names, read synchronously (null until it is known). */
201	  activeId(): string | null;

thread_replies.reply: Confirmed. `SettingsScopeBridge` and its doc now sit at electron-api.ts:168-191. The ADR 0032 JSDoc comes right before `WorkspacesBridge` (193-198).
Confirmed. The hash is now recorded before the folder file is replaced. If the record write fails, the file is left untouched.

Confirmed. `uploadMode` now goes to the machine file without depending on the folder outcome (workspace-settings.ts:296-301). `keptOwn` names a workspace only if it can still hold one of the keys (line 434).
Confirmed. In settings-scope.tsx, `useAppSettings` is now called only in `useScopedSetting` (line 261). The scope consumers no longer each run their own read and listener.
Thanks. The new test calls resolve again after the broadcast and expects 24 and then 60 fps. That assertion can fail, and it matches what the hook actually guarantees.
Confirmed. `copiedKept` is now an ICU plural on `count` in both en.json and es.json, and settings-scope.tsx:184 passes `count`.
Confirmed. `refresh` now drops its read when a write is in flight or the write epoch has moved (workspace-settings.ts:155).
Confirmed. Each refresh takes a ticket when it starts, and a read is applied only if no later ticket has been applied (lines 150-157). The last refresh to start now wins.
Confirmed. `fence` raises the write epoch for the fresh reads in the edit and resolve paths (lines 87-88, 328, 405). A refresh already in flight now drops what it read.
Confirmed. The unreadable-file guard in `copyToAll` now applies only when a key other than `uploadMode` is wanted (lines 457-458).

input.summary: This push fixes two things. In `index.ts`, the previous commit had left `notifyOverridesChanged()` inside the `switchWorkspace` deps object literal, outside `persistActive`. That does not parse. The call now lives in `activeTransactionDeps().afterCommit`, so it runs after every committed active-workspace change: switch and relocate. On a switch, the target's settings are refreshed in `persistActive` before the commit. In the design spec, three `settings:*` rows had been placed above the IPC table's header row, which breaks the Markdown table. They now sit at the end of the table body. I found nothing to flag in either file. I checked all ten earlier threads against the head commit, and each fix is in the code.
